comparison_rules.exact: ints, bools, strings and lists compared for equality after canonical ordering of list-of-dicts by their declared sort key; lists of scalars compared as sorted lists where the key name ends with _set or is nu4_allowed, admissible, admissible_H, tests_holding, loop_images; other lists compared in order
comparison_rules.float: per-key rule (gt/le threshold) evaluated on each leg separately; magnitudes are not compared across legs
comparison_rules.free_text: never compared (any key not declared above is ignored)

harmonizations_v1_1.R1.1-1 sym_int recording (CC-DD-2 / H-A1: phase0.sym_int_continuous and phase0.sym_int_continuous_dim are compared after normalizing each leg's record to the 7-sector (imaginary-sector) continuous symmetry, which is what every test consumes: the label 'G2xU1_psi0' with dim d normalizes to ('G2', d-1); any other label normalizes to itself. A genuine dimension disagreement (e.g. 'G2'/15 vs 'G2'/14) still misses.
harmonizations_v1_1.R1.1-2 automorphism-count domain (CC-DD-: phase1.T2.spinor_2O_automorphism_count: the domain of record is 2O minus {+-Id} (A-2.3's own min-defect domain; 'expected 0'). A leg counting over all of 2O counts exactly one more element (+Id; -Id is never an automorphism). The equality row is therefore vacuous-PASS iff both legs report spinor_2O_min_automorphism_defect > 1e-6 (no non-trivial zero-defect element on either leg) and both counts lie in {0, 1}; otherwise exact equality is required.
harmonizations_v1_1.R1.1-3 H5 P-C booking (CC-DD-3 / H-A1-2(: phase1b.H_screen.H5.i and phase1b.H_screen.H5.code: the non-centrality of e8 (the P-C exclusion of H5) may be booked as criterion (i) = fail (chat) or as the 'centrality' token in the code string with (i) = pass (CC). The two rows are vacuous-PASS iff both legs report P_C.e8_central == false, P_C.e8_anticommutes == true, H5.ii == 'fail', both H5 codes begin 'EXCLUDED(' and contain 'ii', and each leg's booking is internally consistent ((i) == 'fail' iff 'i' is listed in its code; (i) == 'pass' iff 'centrality' is listed). Otherwise exact equality is required. Every other candidate and criterion is compared exactly as in v1.0.

comparison_rules.independence_witness: instrument_md5 must differ between legs; checkpoint bytes need not be identical

schema: G-2a-A1 checkpoint schema v1.1 CANDIDATE r2 (not frozen; supersedes the domain-only candidate 69ffc8fb; H-A1-1 domain widening + three recording-convention harmonizations R1.1-1..3)

verdict_rule: INDETERMINATE if not phase3.controls_all_pass; else UNDECIDED-BY-SUBSTRATE if not phase0.sym_int_pinned; else ASSIGNMENT-II-REALIZABLE if (not phase0.spatial_internal_direct_product) or any of T1..T4 holds == false; else ASSIGNMENT-I-FORCED. controls_all_pass is recomputed by the comparator as the conjunction of: phase0.controls.*, T1.control_sym3_quartet_mult == 1, T2.control_1344_all_automorphisms, T2.spinor_2O_quartet_mult == 2, T3.controls_pi4_S2 == 'Z2', T3.controls_pi4_S3 == 'Z2', T3.controls_pi1_SO3_mod_T == 24, T4.control_F21_unsigned_1_3_3bar, T4.nu2_unsigned_automorphism, phase2.O_zero_on_nonline.
